name: Azreal Yang
source:
Azreal is Ember's companion in Seraphina's graphic novel who is magically bound to her key. Even though he's intimidating and rather grumpy, he has a soft spot for savory foods and would do anything for some nice fired snacks. Because he's trapped to the key, Azreal desperately is seeking his own freedom, hoping that one day he will be able to roam free once again.

[From [url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/written-in-the-stars]itch.io[/url]]
